entities.title: Agent Workflow Contracts
entities.summary: Define compact agent workflows and handoff contracts.
entities.body: Defines how agents communicate with Projectplaner and each other: orient through graph targets, consume compact packets, execute scoped work, and leave durable context for the next agent.

metadata.purpose: Define how agents communicate with Projectplaner and each other.
metadata.userValue: Agents spend fewer tokens rediscovering context and leave useful state for successors.
metadata.behavior: Workflows are graph-attached flow entities; packets and playbooks are reference entities; tasks use these contracts for handoff.
nonGoals: No new schema tables in v1
No automatic subagent spawning in v1
No MCP server in this slice
metadata.acceptanceShape: An agent can find relevant work, consume compact context, execute a task, and leave a packet without rereading broad repo context.

narrative.reason: Shippable capability: Define compact agent workflows and handoff contracts.

entities.title: Use graph entities and references for v1 agent workflows
entities.summary: Use existing generic graph entities for the first agent workflow contracts.
entities.body: Workflows are flow entities, packets and playbooks are reference entities, and attachments use entity_relations_v2. This keeps v1 schema-free while preserving a migration path to MCP or API wrappers.

metadata.context: Agents need durable workflow context without new schema tables yet.
metadata.decision: Use graph entities and references for v1 agent workflows.
metadata.rationale: This proves the workflow model with existing entities and relations before committing to schema or MCP surfaces.
consequences: Workflows are flow entities
Packets and playbooks are reference entities
Attachments use entity_relations_v2

entities.title: Workflow Step Graph v1
entities.summary: v1 schema for workflow nodes/edges, per-task context bags, and tool↔LLM dataflow.
entities.body: Defines how workflow step graphs are stored on flow entities, how per-task context bags move data between tool and LLM nodes, and what each node type may declare. Enrich later; this is the v1 lock.

principles: Tool/function nodes run without LLM and write structured values into declared writes.
LLM nodes receive only: node instructions + reads subset + optional tiny system preamble. Never the whole workflow graph.
Every node declares reads[] and writes[]. Undeclared bag keys are invisible to that node.
Auto context/filter nodes populate the bag before any LLM call.
Between tool and LLM: tools write canonical JSON under writes; LLM reads those keys only. Prefer tool output schemas over prose.
If a step fails validation of writes, stop or route via gate — do not dump errors into unconstrained chat.
toolToLlm: Tool node writes e.g. matches, filteredEntities, createdEntityId
Edge advances to LLM node with reads: ["goal","filteredEntities"]
LLM returns only declared writes e.g. chosenAspectId, rationale
Next tool/write node consumes chosenAspectId without re-asking LLM for full history

llm.instructions: Pick the smallest truthful Aspect id from filteredEntities, or say createNew with a title.

storage.instructions: llm.instructions inline on node, or llm.instructionRef -> reference entity for alternate/reusable prompts
storage.ui: xyflow positions on nodes; Aspect Graph mode remains separate

metadata.style: Compact machine-oriented JSON on flow + task metadata. Nodes hold enough data to parse; runners do not need to serve the whole graph to an LLM.

dataFields.auto: Deterministic ops for context/filter nodes (loadContext, filter, assign) — no LLM
dataFields.gate: askUserIf / stopIf / route expressions over bag keys
dataFields.llm: instructions or instructionRef, tools allowlist, inputKeys, outputSchema
dataFields.reads: bag keys visible to this node
dataFields.title: Human label
dataFields.tool: Function/MCP tool invocation: name + argsFromBag mapping
dataFields.write: Graph write helper for entity create/update when not using generic tool node

workflowEdge.label: optional route name e.g. default | sparse | failed

narrative.reason: Durable contract/reference: v1 schema for workflow nodes/edges, per-task context bags, and tool↔LLM dataflow.
